title: Chat gets images and streaming replies
summary:
Chat gained image attachments and streaming replies, while citations, subscription status, proxy handling, and event retries got attention.

CloudCompile's Hacktoberfest chat app added image paste, drag-and-drop attachments, model search, and replies that appear as text arrives. The updates also improve message formatting and mobile interactions.

Chat responses now preserve citation URLs from Perplexity models. The image service also gained a model-request-count endpoint, with counts subsequently made persistent across server restarts.

Enter's tier panel now distinguishes active, canceled, and absent subscriptions, shows end dates when available, and displays activation errors inline. Separate work prepared Pollen pack checkout configuration and updated the amounts shown on disabled top-up buttons; it did not establish that subscriptions or customer data were migrated.

highlights.title: Chat as replies arrive
highlights.text: CloudCompile's Hacktoberfest chat app now shows streamed replies as text arrives. You can also paste or drop images into a conversation and search for models.
